metadata.description: Claude skills for a student's term of courses: bilingual (English/Korean) lecture notes in XeLaTeX from handouts, handwriting and recordings, a PDF viewer site and a course hub on GitHub Pages, problem books, answer sheets, mock exams and cheat sheets, syncing the student's Mac, and transcribing class recordings.

plugins.name: course-notes
plugins.description: Every skill in this repository, installed together (they share one course template, one viewer and one set of rules).
